summary: Session 2 of 3: custom-clef registration hook implementing the Configurator set-009 anchor contract (backlog item 1.2). New cnb:register-clef! (name def) in cnb/clefs.ly mirrors cnb:register-path! - a deliberate two-argument deviation from the backlog's proposed single-list '(name path-data) shape, recorded for the Session 3 handoff. def is an alist: required path (same nested command format as cnb:notehead-shape-path) and anchor-semitones (a FLOAT per the 009 contract - the semitone position of the glyph's TOP edge), optional height-semitones (design height) and color. Definitions live in a new cnb:clef-defs hash table in clefs.ly (not procedure.ly - recorded decision); structurally invalid defs (including the bare-list shape) warn and are not registered. Selection: cnb:clef-style 'custom + new cnb:clef-name setting (default #f); cnb:clef-effective-style degrades a missing/invalid registration to 'dozenal with a warning so a broken config renders today's display, never an empty slot or a crash. Anchor semantics: anchor-semitones is in the notehead engraver's own pitch coordinate (ly:pitch-semitones, middle C = 0); placement reuses the notehead position formula verbatim via pure helper cnb:clef-anchor-y-offset - Y-offset = (anchor + 2*middleCPosition)/cnb:semitones-per-staff-space * staff-space - so the top edge divides through sps correctly on any staff design; middleCPosition is used as-is (includes ottava, exactly like noteheads - recorded for the handoff). The stencil is built with its top edge at y=0 (uniform scale, aspect preserved). Size precedence (recorded decision): explicit cnb:clef-size-semitones > def height-semitones > native path scale (1 path unit = 1 staff-space). New cnb:clef-gutter-semitones (default #f = legacy spacing; number N widens the built stencil's right X-extent by N/sps * mag staff-spaces of blank space, all rendered styles). Cache handling per spec step 3: the S1 cache key grew the custom clef name ('custom only) and gutter fields, and cnb:register-clef! clears the whole stencil cache since re-registration mutates what a cached 'custom key renders. Tests: unit suite 254/254 (was 209; +45 assertions incl. the pinned 'FLOAT anchor-semitones is accepted' test mirroring the Configurator's, four invalid-def rejections, effective-style fallback, anchor math at sps-1/2/3 with fractional anchors, size precedence, gutter math, and real stencil geometry via make-path-stencil). New integration spec tests/clef-custom.json: a registered 1x2 rectangle clef at anchor 16/height 8/gutter 4 on the default sps-2 treble staff harvests its bbox top edge on the TOP staff line (8.045 vs 8.05) and bottom edge on the BOTTOM line, exact 4-staff-space height, uniform width 2.0, and the gutter-shifted first-notehead x (14.762 vs 13.262 measured no-gutter counterfactual). Integration suite 245/245 (343 assertions, 9 specs) incl. both golden joy-to-the-world specs; zero golden-baseline drift with defaults. README: cnb:register-clef! row + def-format note in the Registration API section, two new Engine Settings rows, style/size rows updated, assertion counts refreshed. Deliverable commit 4e3dd2f.

reason.specifics: Session 2 landed the full engine-side clef contract (style/text/size from S1 + registration/anchor/gutter from S2) with zero baseline drift and every decision point recorded in the change log.
